home.title: Stay active & social — for a cause.
home.sub: We organise competitions, social activities and workshops to raise funds that go to a cause our community chose.

home.slideVoteTextEmpty: You propose the cause, we raise the money. Members vote, the top five make the shortlist, and we take one on.
home.proofLead: What came in, what went out, and the two funds that never mix. Updated the moment a gift is matched or a hand-over is published.
home.whatTitle: You propose the cause. We raise the money.
home.whatLead: Santamore is a Montenegrin non-profit in Tivat. A need is proposed by the community, members vote it onto the shortlist, we take it on, and we raise for it with runs, swims, gatherings and the fundraising pages of our members. Every euro in and out sits in a public ledger.
home.eventsByCauseTitle: What we are raising for, and where
home.eventsByCauseLead: Each cause with the events that raise for it: register, join or come along. Every ticket and every kilometre counts for the cause beside it.
home.eventsNoCauseLead: Gatherings and challenges that keep us together; what they raise goes to the next cause we take on.
home.proposalsLead: Anyone can propose a need in Montenegro. Members vote proposals up, the top five make the shortlist, and we choose one and publish every euro that reaches it.
home.fundraisersLead: Members who opened a page and asked the people they know. Every euro on it goes to the cause.
home.partnersLead: The companies that pay for our team so donations never have to — with what each one gave.
home.causesHeading: What we are raising for right now

dashboard.title: My fundraising page
dashboard.signInSub: One email — a sign-in link or a password, your choice: run partner challenges, earn rewards, and create a fundraising page if you like.

dashboard.cashLogged: Logged — it counts once staff confirm the hand-in.

dashboard.inviteMessage: Come and join me at {name} — we run for Santamore and every euro is published:
dashboard.evSub: Events and causes as they relate to you: going, registered, raising, supported — and everything you have given, at the bottom.

dashboard.fundraiseFinishedSub: Pages open for causes that are still raising. Pick the next one.
dashboard.fundraiseStep1Body: A fundraiser page carries your name, a photo, a few sentences and a goal. Donors give to you; the money goes to the cause.
dashboard.fundraiseStep1Point1: It stays a draft until you publish it.
dashboard.fundraiseStep1Point2: Your name is what donors and the leaderboard see.
dashboard.fundraiseStep1Point3: You can join a team so your total counts twice — for you and for them.
dashboard.fundraiseStep2Body: Donors pay by bank transfer with a reference that points at your page. We match it and it shows up on your page and in the public ledger.
dashboard.fundraiseStep2Point1: 100% of donations reach beneficiaries; fees are covered separately.
dashboard.fundraiseStep2Point2: Cash you collect in person can be logged from your page.
dashboard.fundraiseStep2Point3: Every euro in and out is public — that is the whole point.
dashboard.fundraiseStep3Body: A link and a QR code do the work. Send them to the people who would give because it is you asking.
dashboard.fundraiseStep3Point1: Share from your page in one tap.
dashboard.fundraiseStep3Point2: For challenges, connect Strava and your activity counts automatically.
dashboard.fundraiseStep3Point3: Ask the team for a shirt, a photo, a story — it all goes on the page.
dashboard.fundraiseNoCause: This event has no cause to raise for
dashboard.fundraiseNoCauseSub: Pages raise money for a cause; this event (a sponsored challenge, for instance) has none attached. Pick a cause instead.

forms.success_volunteer: Thank you! We'll be in touch before the next event.
forms.success_partner: Thank you — we'll reply with our partner sheet.
forms.success_newsletter: You're on the list. See you in December.

kontakt.title: Contact
kontakt.sub: Write to us about anything — donations, events, partnerships, or a family that needs help.
kontakt.mapNote: [[PLACEHOLDER: map embed once the registered address is confirmed]]

volunteer.title: Volunteer with us
volunteer.sub: Our events run on neighbours who show up. Tell us who you are and we'll find you a job with a red suit attached.
volunteer.role1: Event day: course marshals, water stations, finish-line medals, the kids' race.
volunteer.role2: Before the event: packet packing, poster runs, translation, photography.
volunteer.role3: All year: cash counting (always in pairs), social media, welcoming new runners.

apply.title: Apply for help
apply.sub: Anyone can apply — no connections required. Families in crisis, children and youth, small local businesses after a disaster, and local organisations.
apply.step1Desc: An open form. No connections required.
apply.step2Desc: Majority not employed by us; conflicts declared and recused; criteria published.
apply.step3Desc: And published in the ledger within 30 days of that, with documentation.
apply.contactLabel: How can we reach you (phone or email)
apply.descriptionLabel: Tell us what happened and what would help
apply.success: Received. The committee reviews applications against published criteria; we will contact you either way.

events.title: Events
events.sub: Joyful, physical, public — and every euro they raise lands in the ledger.
events.signInSub: One email — the same account runs your fundraising page.
events.waiver1: I take part at my own risk and confirm I am medically fit for the activity I chose.
events.waiver2: I understand minors take part with guardian consent, and that photos and video from the event may be published — I can opt out at the info point.
events.waiver3: Withdrawal, transfer and bad-weather rules are part of the event terms.
events.waiverFull: Read the full event terms and waiver
events.waiverAccept: I have read and accept the event terms and waiver
events.payInstructions: One step left: transfer your entry fee with the reference below and we'll confirm your place, usually within one working day.
events.opsNote: Entry fees fund the event and our team (Operations Fund) — donations still go 100% to beneficiaries.
events.paidNote: Entry fee received. See you at the start line.
events.noFeeNote: No entry fee due. See you at the start line.
events.emptyKind: Nothing of this kind is posted yet.
events.noUpcoming: Nothing scheduled right now — the past ones are below.
events.finishedNote: This event is over. See you at the next one.
events.wayRunSub: Register yourself, or someone you bring along. The entry fee funds the event; donations never do.
events.wayJoinSub: Register, connect Strava, and every qualifying activity counts towards the rewards.
events.wayGoingSub: Tell us you're coming so we know how many to expect.
events.wayRaiseSub: Open your own page for the cause, share it, and every euro lands in the public ledger.
events.shirtsNote: Event shirts are handed out at the start — you pick the size when you register.
events.howStep1: Sign in and connect Strava — no fundraising page needed.
events.howStep2: Move during the period: every qualifying activity is checked automatically.
events.howStep3: Hit the rule and a reward code appears on your page — show it at the partner.
events.joinSignInSub: One email. Then connect Strava once, and every qualifying activity counts.
events.wayRunExternalSub: This race is organised by someone else. Register with them, then join our team here so we know you run in our colours — and raise money for the cause if you like.
events.bibsLeft: We buy a limited number of bibs for the team — {count} left.
events.needBib: I need a bib from Santamore
events.bibsGone: Our bibs for this race are all taken — register with the organiser and still join the team.
events.guestsHint: Up to {count} guests. We need each name.
events.externalNote: Organised by others · you register with them
events.wayRunOrganizer: Register with the organiser, run for Santamore
events.wayRunOrganizerSub: {name} organises this race and takes the registrations. Sign up with them, then tell us you run in our colours — and raise money for the cause if you like.
events.wayRunTeamSub: {name} organises this race. We register the team and pay for the places in one go, so you register and pay here.

gallery.title: The bay, on its feet
gallery.sub: Photos from our events — published with consent, credited to the people who took them.
gallery.empty: Photos from our next event will appear here — published with consent.

news.title: What happened, and what's next
news.sub: Event announcements, results and reports — the same facts as the ledger, in sentences.
news.empty: No posts yet. The first one lands with our next event.

consent.label: Cookie notice
consent.text: We use privacy-friendly analytics (Plausible) only if you agree. No ad trackers, ever.

campaigns.title: Causes
campaigns.sub: What we are raising for right now, how far along it is, and who the money reaches. Every euro in and out is in the public ledger.
campaigns.promise: 100% of donations reach beneficiaries. Fees are covered separately and shown in the ledger.
campaigns.fundraisersLink: See the fundraisers and teams raising for it →
campaigns.ledgerSub: Direct gifts to this cause, plus every euro raised on its fundraising pages.
campaigns.ledgerOutNote: Money out is decided per chapter and published with its paperwork.

perks.title: Partner challenges
perks.sub: Run the rule, earn the reward. Partners in the Bay set a daily challenge — do it, and show the code at their counter.
perks.step1: Connect Strava to your Santamore account once.
perks.step2: Do the run. Strava tells us; a qualifying activity earns a code.
perks.step3: Open the code on your phone and show the QR at the partner. They tap once and it is yours.
perks.empty: No active challenges at the moment.
perks.leftToday: {count, plural, =0 {None left today} one {# left today} other {# left today}}
perks.howNote: Rewards need a connected Strava account with public activities.
perks.ruleElevation: with at least {elevation} m of climbing
perks.ruleCaps: Up to {perUser, plural, one {# reward} other {# rewards}} per athlete per day.
perks.ruleValid: Codes are valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
perks.redeemHint: Enter your partner PIN to mark this reward as redeemed. It can be redeemed once.

redeemOutcome.locked: Too many attempts — try again in 15 minutes.
redeemOutcome.revoked: This code is no longer valid (the activity was removed).

perks.awardNote: This page shows the reward only — never the underlying Strava activity.
perks.rulePace: at a pace of {pace} /km or faster
perks.ruleDaysPeriod: on {days} different days during the challenge
perks.noPageNeeded: No fundraising page needed: sign in with your email, connect Strava, run.

strava.title: Strava
strava.sub: Connect Strava to earn partner rewards for your runs and to count activities on challenge standings.
strava.shareLabel: Show my activities on public challenge standings
strava.shareHint: Off by default. Your activities are otherwise visible only to you; rewards show only the reward, never the run.
strava.disconnectHint: Disconnecting revokes our access at Strava and deletes every Strava activity we stored. Rewards you already earned stay valid.
strava.connectSub: We read your public activities (distance, time, date) to check partner challenge rules. Nothing is posted to Strava.
strava.privacyNote: You can disconnect at any time here or from Strava's settings; we then delete the activities we stored.
strava.statusConnected: Strava connected. Today's runs are being checked against the challenges.
strava.statusScope: Strava did not grant activity access — please allow "View data about your activities".
strava.statusTaken: That Strava account is already linked to another Santamore account.
strava.statusState: The sign-in link expired — start again.
strava.statusUnconfigured: Strava is not configured on this site yet.
strava.syncDone: Synced {imported, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}}, {awards, plural, =0 {no new rewards} one {# new reward} other {# new rewards}}.
strava.syncThrottled: Already synced recently — try again in a few minutes.
strava.activitiesEmpty: No runs in the last 8 weeks. Record one with the Strava app — it appears here within a minute of finishing.
strava.unconfiguredStaffHint: Staff: set STRAVA_CLIENT_ID, STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET and STRAVA_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN, then register the webhook under Admin → Partner perks (docs/STRAVA.md).
strava.nurtureHeading: Your runs could also raise money
strava.nurtureBody: You are connected and earning rewards. A fundraising page turns the same runs into support for families in the Bay — a photo, a goal, three sentences.
strava.statusCredentials: Strava rejected this site's app credentials. Staff: check STRAVA_CLIENT_ID and STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET in the deployment.
strava.progressEmpty: No active partner challenges right now.
strava.progressEarned: Reward earned for this window — see it below.
strava.scopePartialHint: Private runs are not included yet — reconnect and allow access to all activities.
strava.manualEntry: Manual entry — counts only where the partner allows it
strava.trendCaption: Distance per week over the last {weeks} weeks
strava.trendEmpty: Your weekly trend appears after your first synced run.
strava.rewardsNoneReady: Nothing waiting — every reward you earned is redeemed or expired.
strava.autoSyncNote: New runs arrive on their own within a minute; the page also refreshes when you open it.
strava.trendEmptyDisconnected: Connect Strava to see kilometres per week.
strava.activitiesEmptyDisconnected: Your runs from the last 8 weeks appear here once connected.

giving.title: My giving
giving.sub: Every donation made with {email}, with receipts and the ledger entry. Donations you made anonymously are still listed here — only you can see this page.
giving.feesNote: Includes {amount} you added to cover fees — thank you, it keeps 100% of donations for beneficiaries.
giving.monthlyManageNote: Changing the amount or cancelling: self-service arrives with the card rail; until then write to us.
giving.empty: No donations with this email yet.
giving.pendingSepa: We have not matched a transfer for this pledge yet. Quote this reference in the transfer, and we credit it usually within one working day.
giving.privacyNote: Matching is by your verified sign-in email. If you gave with a different address, sign in with that one to see those donations.

years.pastLead: Every figure below comes from the ledger for that year. The story is ours; the numbers are the database's.
years.currentLead: Year to date, live from the ledger. It changes every time a gift is matched or a hand-over is published.
years.futureLead: What we intend to do. Figures fill in as the year happens.
years.noEvents: No events dated in this year yet.
years.noSupporters: No sponsors attached to this year yet.
years.noBeneficiaries: No hand-overs published for this year yet.
years.noReport: The story of this year is not written yet.
years.legacyNote: Some of this year's figures were recorded by the team before this ledger existed, not derived row by row.
years.giftSponsorNote: Sponsorships go to the Operations Fund: they pay for our team so donations never have to.
years.giftDonationNote: Donations go to the Impact Fund: 100% reaches the beneficiaries, not one cent to salaries or overhead.
years.noDonorsYet: No donor recorded for this year yet.
years.runnersNote: {count, plural, =0 {No confirmed registration at this year's events.} one {# confirmed registration at this year's events.} other {# confirmed registrations at this year's events.}}
years.noPages: No fundraising page on this year's causes.
years.noTeams: No team on this year's causes.
years.noVolunteers: No volunteer recorded for this year yet.
years.sponsorAllImpact: all of it handed to the beneficiaries
years.sponsorPartImpact: {amount} of it handed to the beneficiaries
years.giftImpactNote: This sponsorship went to the Impact Fund: handed to the beneficiaries in full, like a donation, with nothing held back for operations.
years.giftMixedNote: Part of it went to the beneficiaries instead.

proposals.title: Propose a cause
proposals.sub: Know a need we should take on? Tell us. A few questions first, then the proposal — what passes is listed for members to vote up, and we choose from the top five.
proposals.listSub: Members vote a proposal up; the five with most votes are on the shortlist we choose from.
proposals.empty: No proposals yet — be the first.
proposals.screeningSub: We can only take on some needs. Answer honestly; we say straight away if this is not one for us.
proposals.notForUs: This is not a cause we can take on
proposals.notForUsSub: Thank you for thinking of it. Here is why it falls outside what we do — a cause that fits our criteria is very welcome.
proposals.summaryLabel: What is the need and who has it?
proposals.summaryHint: A few sentences. At least 40 characters.
proposals.amountLabel: Roughly how much would it take (€)
proposals.submitted: Thank you — your proposal is listed
proposals.submittedSub: Share it so people vote it up. The top five are the shortlist we choose from.
proposals.signInSub: One email. A proposal carries a name, and a member votes once.

beneficiaries.title: Who your euro reached
beneficiaries.sub: The centres, homes and families our causes reached, in their own words and ours. Every hand-over to them sits in the public ledger.
beneficiaries.empty: The first stories appear here once a hand-over is published.
